children: ACP Holdings Acquisition signed a Business Combination Agreement to merge with May Mobility in a stock-for-stock SPAC transaction valuing May Mobility at $1.35 billion. The deal is backed by a $120 million PIPE of 12% convertible preferred with matching warrants and a suite of voting, lock-up, and registration rights agreements aimed at ensuring closing and post-merger trading stability. Approvals from ACP shareholders, May Mobility stockholders, HSR clearance, and Nasdaq listing are required, with an Outside Date of May 26, 2027.

: Sponsor Support Agreement with earnout and voting covenants
: Through Closing; earnout up to 6 years

Agreement 3: May Mobility Holders Sign Voting Agreements to Support ACP Merger
Agreement 4: ACP to Implement 12-Month Sponsor Lock-Up at Closing

: Cyrus Capital Partners funds and Keyframe Capital Fund III
: Stabilize shareholder base and support post-merger liquidity

: Sponsor, PIPE investors, Cantor and other holders
